# TSA23 FEMIC Instance

> Agent-facing index for the TSA23 instance. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [Overview](overview.html): what the instance is and how it is laid out.
- [Quickstart](quickstart.html): build and run it from a clean checkout.
- [Rebuild contract](rebuild-contract.html): the canonical rebuild sequence.
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.html): known failures and their causes.

## Reference

- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.
- [TSR guidance](tsr-guidance.html): reading and reviewing the TSR candidate facts.
- [Seral interpretation](seral-interpretation.html): the seral-stage rules used in the model.

## Beyond this site

- `AGENTS.md` and `ROADMAP.md` in the repository are the governing instructions and the plan of record.
- `planning/paper2_evidence_log.md` holds the measured evidence behind every reported number.
- `planning/bridge_experiment_log.md` holds the exact command for each experiment.
- `runbooks/` holds the operator procedures.
